audit.whatIsWrong: The lane-difficulty story was generic. The actual reason this is 8/10 is the 850-to-650 range gap on Avengerang and the fact that Akshan's damage is physical, so Null Sphere's shield — which absorbs magic damage — does almost nothing.
audit.why: Riot: Null Sphere 'grants a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage'; Kassadin's passive also reduces magic damage. Akshan's Q is 850 range to Kassadin's 650.
audit.corrected: tradeGood, breakdown.early, phases[1].why and dontsFull[0].d now state the range gap and the damage-type mismatch.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes was the generic Kassadin clock line, and spikes[1].text claimed Comeuppance 'doesn't help him vs you directly' at level 6.
audit.why: Comeuppance is 100/85/70, 2500 range, and deals damage based on MISSING health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit. It absolutely threatens you in lane — and the same text gives the counterplay: a minion in the line eats the bullets.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text rewritten with the range, the missing-health scaling and the minion block; breakdown.spikes keyed to the first-item flip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent. First: Heroic Swing 'fires a grappling hook into terrain' and he 'gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain' — so no wall means no swing, and standing in the arc ends it. Second: Comeuppance's bullets stop on the first champion, minion or structure hit, so a minion body cancels the whole ult.
audit.why: Both are literal in Riot's descriptions and neither reached the page; the page instead described Heroic Swing only as 'his swing engage/escape'.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[1].d, breakdown.carry, breakdown.feeding and spikes[1].text now carry them.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit at all (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT).
audit.corrected: All three written in, plus the terrain requirement on the swing.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t says 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain'. Akshan has no healing in his kit — Dirty Fighting grants a SHIELD, not a heal.
audit.why: Riot: 'Every three hits ... deals bonus damage and grants him a Shield if the target was a champion.' Grievous Wounds does nothing to a shield. Against all-physical damage the real buy is armour.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal clause replaced with armour boots.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were the tradeGood/tradeBad strings pasted under unrelated titles; wants.foe[1] invented both a 'passive stealth in brush' and a Null Sphere 'silence'.
audit.why: Akshan's camouflage comes from Going Rogue (W), not his passive. Null Sphere interrupts channels; Riot's text gives it no silence.
audit.corrected: Both bullets given matching bodies; wants.foe[1] rewritten to name Going Rogue and a sweeper.

audit.why: 49.07% over 1017 games; no elo split written.

edits.after: Akshan wins by poking with an 850-range Avengerang and finishing with Comeuppance while you have no way to close.

edits.before: Trading like the late game already arrived — a level 5 Kassadin with ambitions is a gold bounty with a shield.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Riftwalk has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
